name: Mundowow
storyline: Mundowow is a theme park–like online world made of a central plaza and several themed districts and worlds, such as an Aztec area, a space zone, a Far West town, an Asian temple, a magic kingdom and a K-pop district. Players arrive as visitors, create their own avatar and explore the park, meet other players, join minigames and build their own rooms.
summary: Mundowow is a free-to-play social online game in pixel art that runs in the web browser on phones and computers. Players create an avatar, explore a central plaza and themed districts, chat by text or proximity voice, and decorate their own rooms. The game includes multiplayer minigames such as 3v3 football, a K-pop rhythm game (Idol Dance), team robot battles and "The Floor is Lava", with weekly rankings, collectible photocards and outfits.
